context: Now it has appeared in space. NIRSpec, an instrument on JWST, picked up a “line of light.” But this time, researchers turned the usual steps around. Usually, researchers choose an object in an image to study.
They could not confirm that an image showed an object where the line was. Then the investigation took an unexpected turn. The fact that it “doesn’t show up” became evidence.

## In one line JWST found the line many times, but deep images showed no object there. That absence helped set a lower limit for its equivalent width, but more observations are needed to find its source.
